request: Create Certifications (certificate name and expiry date), each linked to the customer or supplier it belongs to, and Audits (audit date and score), each linked to a certification.

outcome.renderedDiff:
New record type "Audit" with 3 fields:
  - Audit name (text, required)
  - Audit date (date)
  - Score (whole number)
  It gets its own menu entry "Audit" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Audit records.
New record type "Certification" with 2 fields:
  - Certificate name (text, required)
  - Expiry date (date)
  It gets its own menu entry "Certification" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Certification records.
New optional link "Certification" from Audit to Certification. Choose it when creating a record.
New optional link "Customer or supplier" from Certification to Party. Choose it when creating a record.

Stored data: 2 new tables, 4 new indexes, 2 addForeignKey x2. Nothing already stored is changed or removed.
Rolling back hides this change again and keeps every record entered under it.
